title: dsh-passwords 2.7.7: minting a seat again keeps its open tabs working, and a seat's request to an unlisted route never reaches dsh
steps: S1: In vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords run: npm ci

S2: In vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords run: node --import tsx --test --test-timeout=120000 test/tracy/seat-remint.test.ts test/tracy/seat-unknown-routes.test.ts test/tracy/request-path.test.ts; then node --import tsx --test test/tracy/seat-tool-guard.test.ts
S3: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'L1: minting the same seat again leaves its open tabs working (no 403 folderDenied)' passes.
'L1/V6: minting the seat with another role still drops its access snapshot at once' passes.
'L1: signing in again through the Tracy door leaves the open tabs working; a moved role does not' passes.
'L3/R12: a seat's request to an unlisted route is refused 403 at the gateway; dsh hears nothing' passes.
'L3/R12: every route the seat UI was measured to call still reaches dsh' and 'every route a loaded plugin's client calls for a seat still reaches dsh' pass.
'L3/R12: the gateway master keeps upstream behaviour: an unlisted route still reaches dsh' passes.
'L3/R12: dsh RPCs closed to seats answer empty at the gateway, not 403; dsh hears nothing' passes.
'L3/Q2: a bodyless POST to a listed plugin route reaches dsh; a non-JSON body is still refused' passes.
Native code writes re-read current seat permissions after approval; owned children cannot borrow an actor from rejected or unstamped input.

tests: every code dispatch reads current authority; downgrade, ban and deletion deny before the body
real native tools refuse a downgraded seat after an extensible pre-execute allow and before the body
a resumed owned child accepts the current parent continuation but never an unstamped browser user
